title: Penguin wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4a5a8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a2f5a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='89' rx='8' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd97a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='89' rx='8' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd97a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='27' ry='29' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='18' ry='22' fill='#f2f2f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='15' ry='17' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='62' rx='7' ry='17' transform='rotate(12 24 62)' fill='#3a4570'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='62' rx='7' ry='17' transform='rotate(-12 76 62)' fill='#3a4570'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='22' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#f2f2f5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='34' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='34.5' r='2.2' fill='#2a2f5a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34.5' r='2.2' fill='#2a2f5a'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='33.6' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='33.6' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='50,40 44,45 56,45' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <polygon points='50,41 46,44.5 54,44.5' fill='#ffc04d'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,2 36,22 64,22' fill='#e84a8a'/>
  <polygon points='50,2 43,22 57,22' fill='#ff7ab0'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='15' x2='60' y2='15' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='3.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
